title: The receipt of every successful board mutation (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Never carries an estate-wide sequence number (C3) or another Project's data: an unknown member is refused.

repeated.description: true: the same idempotency key and digest were already stored, and this is that receipt; for a com.progress note, the note was already posted under this attempt and key; for com.read_ack, the reader had already marked the message read. com.renew and com.progress without a note store nothing and answer false.

message.description: The message this call stored or acknowledged.

at.description: When the message was stored, or for com.read_ack when the reader first marked it read.

request.description: The request this call created or moved, after the call.

leaseExpiresAt.description: Database time; the caller's clock is not authoritative.

slot.description: The responder slot the caller holds after com.enroll, com.responder_replace, com.renew or com.progress.

attempt.description: The attempt com.claim opened, or whose lease com.renew or com.progress extended: the values the caller's next fence carries.
